heading: Rules of procedure for panels and committees

tree.heading: Rules of procedure for binational panels
tree.text: The administering authority shall prescribe rules, negotiated in accordance with paragraph 14 of article 10.12, governing, with respect to binational panel reviews—

children.text: requests for such reviews, complaints, other pleadings, and other papers;
the amendment, filing, and service of such pleadings and papers;
the joinder, suspension, and termination of such reviews; and

tree.heading: Rules of procedure for extraordinary challenge committees
tree.text: The administering authority shall prescribe rules, negotiated in accordance with paragraph 2 of Annex 10–B.3, governing the procedures for reviews by extraordinary challenge committees.

tree.heading: Rules of procedure for safeguarding panel review system
tree.text: The administering authority shall prescribe rules, negotiated in accordance with Annex 10–B.4, governing the procedures for special committees described in such Annex.

tree.heading: Publication of rules
tree.text: The rules prescribed under subsections (a), (b), and (c) shall be published in the Federal Register.

tree.heading: Administering authority
tree.text: As used in this section, the term “administering authority” has the meaning given such term in section 1677(1) of this title.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 3435 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 116–113.
